chat: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you've had this painful ulcer on your leg, and has it changed in size or appearance since it first appeared? Also, have you noticed any fever, chills, or red streaks spreading from the wound?

It's been about a month since this started as a small red spot after an ant bite, and it has grown into a painful ulcer with a necrotic center and purplish borders. I haven't experienced any fever, chills, or red streaks spreading from the wound, but my legs are quite swollen with dilated veins.
The ulcer has been there for about three weeks, and it has gotten slightly larger with a purulent discharge. I do have a low-grade fever and some redness spreading around the edges.
